newsitem.title: USA: Two typhoons threaten shipping in Far East - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Two typhoons threaten shipping in Far East - WSC.

text.p: Typhoon Zane is a strong risk to shipping during the next 24-36 hours as it moves from east-northeast of Luzon Philippines to southeast of Taiwan, Weather Services Corp said.
Top winds are currently 105 mph but they may reach 130 mph in 36 hours. After 36 hours this most dangerous typhoon may threaten Taiwan or the southern Ryukyu islands of the East China Sea.

Typhoon Yates, with 140 mph winds, is an extreme threat to shipping near 17n/143e in the western Pacific, west of the Mariana Islands. It is moving west northwest at 10 mph and will remain very powerful but may weaken slightly during the next 24-36 hours as it turns more to the north.
